model_description: Candidate005's frozen learned ensemble handles Tiers 1-6 unchanged. Moduli from 129 through 256 bits route to the frozen EXP701 teacher-cosine H92 two-cycle width-independent cellular specialist. Inputs above the learned 256-bit boundary retain the deterministic zero fallback.
training_description: Candidate005 is byte-frozen through Tier 6. The added Tier-7 checkpoint is EXP701 teacher_cosine from formal root 20261414 (4,800 updates), selected by the preregistered four-arm full-denominator factorial completed by EXP703. Candidate006 integration performs no additional training or answer-based tuning.
